subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR land as the bootstrap-context event-loop stall fix despite the compatibility-sensitive internal glob walker and bootstrap hook scheduling changes?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness finding and keeps SDK signatures stable, but it intentionally changes runtime traversal and scheduling semantics that can affect prompt/context bytes and Gateway responsiveness beyond what focused tests fully settle.

options.title: Accept the internal scheduling tradeoff
options.body: Proceed after normal maintainer review because the branch directly addresses the linked P1 stall path, keeps public SDK surface stable, and has exact-head checks passing.

options.title: Require full live embedded_run proof
options.body: Hold merge until a connected channel or Gateway run demonstrates channel I/O stays responsive through bootstrap-context under a broad workspace glob.

options.title: Split or replace the patch
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the custom glob traversal or hook scheduling reviewed as smaller owner-authored changes.

recommendation.title: Accept the internal scheduling tradeoff
recommendation.body: Proceed after normal maintainer review because the branch directly addresses the linked P1 stall path, keeps public SDK surface stable, and has exact-head checks passing.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected bootstrap read, bootstrap hook, and internal hook history points most strongly to this owner for accepting or rejecting the runtime tradeoff.
